#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <utility>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

class Graph {
public:
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<ll> weight;
    vector<ll> capacity;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount) : vertexCount(vertexCount), edgeCount(0) {
        firstOutbound = vector<int>(vertexCount, -1);
        from = vector<int>(vertexCount);
        to = vector<int>(vertexCount);
        nextOutbound = vector<int>(vertexCount);
        flags = vector<int>(vertexCount);
    }

    Graph(int vertexCount, int edgeCapacity) : vertexCount(vertexCount), edgeCount(0) {
        firstOutbound = vector<int>(vertexCount, -1);
        from = vector<int>(edgeCapacity);
        to = vector<int>(edgeCapacity);
        nextOutbound = vector<int>(edgeCapacity);
        flags = vector<int>(edgeCapacity);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, ll weight, ll capacity, int reverseEdge) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        this->from[edgeCount] = fromID;
        this->to[edgeCount] = toID;
        if (capacity != 0) {
            if (this->capacity.empty()) {
                this->capacity = vector<ll>(from.size());
            }
            this->capacity[edgeCount] = capacity;
        }
        if (weight != 0) {
            if (this->weight.empty()) {
                this->weight = vector<ll>(from.size());
            }
            this->weight[edgeCount] = weight;
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll weight, ll capacity) {
        if (capacity == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -weight, 0, -1);
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, capacity, -1);
        }
    }

    int vertexCount() {
        return vertexCount;
    }

    int firstOutbound(int vertex) {
        return firstOutbound[vertex];
    }

    int nextOutbound(int id) {
        return nextOutbound[id];
    }

    int source(int id) {
        return from[id];
    }

    int destination(int id) {
        return to[id];
    }

    ll weight(int id) {
        if (weight.empty()) return 0;
        return weight[id];
    }

    ll capacity(int id) {
        if (capacity.empty()) return 0;
        return capacity[id];
    }

    void pushFlow(int id, ll flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return;
        capacity[id] -= flow;
    }

    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }

    bool isSparse() {
        return vertexCount == 0 || (ll)edgeCount * 20 / vertexCount <= vertexCount;
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
private:
    const Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;
    int vertexCount;

public:
    MinCostFlow(const Graph& graph, int source, int destination, bool hasNegativeEdges) 
        : graph(graph), source(source), destination(destination), vertexCount(graph.vertexCount()) {
        phi = vector<ll>(vertexCount);
        dijkstraResult = vector<ll>(vertexCount);
        lastEdge = vector<int>(vertexCount, -1);
        visited = vector<int>(vertexCount);
        visitIndex = 0;
        
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
    }

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int head = 0, end = 1;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == (int)queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                ll total = phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[end++] = dest;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                        if (end == (int)queue.size()) end = 0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    pll minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    pll minCostMaxFlow(ll maxFlow) {
        ll cost = 0, flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return make_pair(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            ll currentFlow = maxFlow;
            ll currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weight(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return make_pair(cost, flow);
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        
        priority_queue<pll, vector<pll>, greater<pll>> pq;
        pq.push({0, source});
        
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist, current] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            
            if (dist > dijkstraResult[current]) continue;
            
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        pq.push({dijkstraResult[next], next});
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        visitIndex++;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            int index = -1;
            ll length = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; j++) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) return;
            visited[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(index);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visited[next] != visitIndex) {
                        ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    
    Graph g(n + 100);
    int src = n + 100 - 2;
    int tgt = src + 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; i++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i, tgt, 0, 2);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(src, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] == i + 'a') w = -max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            } else {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] == i + 'a') w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] == i + 'a') w -= a[n - j - 1];
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, src, tgt, true);
    auto result = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -result.first << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
